g.text: Your servers run a small agent that dials out to one control plane. Everything else is HTTPS.
one Docker Compose stack on one host - /opt/falak - falak-ctl
Caddy: the single entry point. Let's Encrypt TLS for the panel,
for work; the Go relay pipes
Loki logs - Tempo traces - VictoriaMetrics metrics - Grafana, alerts
one Go binary (~17 MB RAM). Runs commands, converges the desired
state, ships metrics and logs, opens terminals. Never listens.
containers with scheduled backups and one-click restore
nftables firewall, SSH hardening, no inbound port for Falak
How a build and a deploy happen
One build, then every server gets the same release. Any failed step rolls every server back.
and a build for the commit
the control plane sends deploy.rollback to every server:
all go back to the previous release, and an alert goes out
